response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital is fintech-adjacent but focused on Node/TypeScript, not trading systems), and no SQL Server/Oracle exposure is evident.
strengths: Broad senior engineering experience with strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Solid DevOps, scripting, and messaging-adjacent infrastructure knowledge
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, over a decade ago) versus required 5–10 years
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle experience; recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js, not Windows C++

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD proficiency
